name: ownpg
description: PostgreSQL DBA tools over MCP, scoped to one database and one schema.
long_description: OwnPG connects Claude Desktop to one PostgreSQL database and one schema. Every statement is parsed and classified before it runs, the access mode decides what is allowed, destructive changes ask for confirmation, and an append-only audit log records every call.

tools.name: pg_list_objects
tools.description: List objects in the scoped schema

tools.name: pg_doctor
tools.description: Report the connection and its settings

prompts.name: diagnose_slow_query
prompts.text: Diagnose why one statement is slow and what would make it faster.

prompts.name: review_indexes
prompts.text: Review the indexes of one table.

prompts.name: plan_column_change
prompts.text: Plan a column change that keeps the table available.
